title: Add opt-in strict parsing to `ms`
summary: Support `ms(value, { strict: true })` so an unparseable string throws a plain `Error` whose message contains the offending input. Preserve existing parsing rules and default behavior.

decisions.title: Use `{ strict
decisions.question: Use `{ strict: true }` on the existing `ms()` call; add no new function.

decisions.title: Throw a plain `Error` containing the offending input.
decisions.question: Throw a plain `Error` containing the offending input. Use the message defined above.

decisions.title: Change only `index.js` and `readme.md`.
decisions.question: Change only `index.js` and `readme.md`. Do not add or change test files or dependencies.
